item: Consistency with prior plans such as the district unit plan
checkpoints: Confirm consistency between the environmental impact assessment and the district unit plan
Confirm the building limit line, maximum number of floors, floor height restriction, etc.
Confirm parking count, buffer green space, agreement of the perpendicular layout, low-rise placement zones, etc.
comments: For site entrances and similar plan elements, coordinate with the department responsible for higher-level plans such as the traffic impact assessment and incorporate the agreed adjustments where necessary.
checkpoints_ko: □ 환경영향평가 및 지구단위계획 간 일치여부 확인
□ 건축한계선, 최고층수, 층고제한 등 확인
□ 주차대수, 완충녹지, 직각배치 일치여부, 저층배치구간 등 확인
comments_ko: 단지내 출입구 등 계획은 필요시 교통영향평가 등 상위계획 담당부서와 협의하여 조정, 반영

item: Provision of dwelling units for the housing vulnerable in rental housing
checkpoints: Apply 8% or more in the Seoul metropolitan area and 5% or more in provincial areas
basis: Enforcement Decree of the Housing-Vulnerable Support Act, Article 5
checkpoints_ko: □ 수도권은 8% 이상, 지방은 5% 이상 적용

item: Appropriateness of gate post planning at the main site entrance
checkpoints: Provide sufficient separation between the crosswalk and the gate post to secure sight lines for pedestrian protection
Secure a sidewalk width of 1.5m or more beside internal roads and install a road 7m or wider including the sidewalk
Secure a gate post height of 4.5m or more where fire truck access is considered
Install a pedestrian barrier fence between the gate post columns
comments: Gate post height: 4m under the legal standard, 4.5m under the internal standard, and 5m per the National Fire Agency standard manual
other: Improve the design, for example with a safety fence, so pedestrians cannot walk between the gate post columns
basis: Site Quality Control Team-1961 ('15.6.29) · Standard Manual for Processing Consent for Building Permits, etc. ('23.12, National Fire Agency) · Design Guideline Article 14 (p. 48)
checkpoints_ko: □ 횡단보도와 문주는 충분히 이격하여 보행자 보호를 위한 시야각 확보
□ 단지 내 도로 옆 보도폭은 1.5m이상 확보하고 보도를 포함한 폭 7m 이상 도로 설치
□ 소방차 진입 고려시 문주 높이 4.5m 이상 확보
□ 문주 기둥사이 보행차단 휀스 설치
comments_ko: 문주높이: 법 기준 4m, 내부기준 4.5m, 소방청 표준매뉴얼 5m로 규정
other_ko: 문주 기둥사이로 보행할 수 없도록 안전펜스 등 디자인 개선
basis_ko:
현장품질관리단-1961('15.6.29)
건축허가 등의 동의 업무처리 표준 매뉴얼(`23.12, 소방청)
설계지침 제14조(48쪽)

item: Appropriateness of vehicle access planning at the site entrance
checkpoints: Secure the driveway width in consideration of the 0.5m installation width of the barrier gate base pad
Locate the access control system on the driver's side (left in the direction of travel)
Install the visitor lane facing the guard booth so that it is visible from the booth
Separate the access lanes for residents and visitors
Where there are 3 or fewer entry/exit lanes, plan reversible entry and exit lanes
comments: To prevent complaints about vehicle congestion, secure a vehicle queuing space from the barrier gate sized for 2 compact cars (approx. 10m)
other: Where the traffic impact assessment requires a change to the entry/exit lane plan, coordinate with the relevant department and incorporate it
checkpoints_ko: □ 차단기 기초패드 설치너비(0.5m)를 고려하여 차도 폭 확보
□ 출입통제 시스템 위치는 진행방향 좌측 운전석으로 계획
□ 방문자 차로는 경비실에서 보이는 방향으로 설치
□ 출입차로는 입주자와 방문자로 분리하여 계획
□ 진출입 차로가 3차로 이하인 경우 진입, 진출 가변형으로 계획
comments_ko: 차량 혼잡 민원예방을 위해 차단기로부터 소형차 2대 기준(약 10m) 차량 대기공간 확보 필요
other_ko: 교통영향평가상 진출입차로 계획 변경이 필요한 경우 관련 부서와 협의하여 반영

item: Appropriateness of planning for children's school-vehicle stops
checkpoints: Install a median at the main entrance or a roundabout so that school vehicles can stop
Separate the circulation routes of general vehicles and school vehicles (planting bed recommended)
Install pavement markings and signage to identify the school-vehicle stop
Do not plan the stop where a crosswalk is installed
Install safety facilities such as convex mirrors and vehicle-exit warning signs where necessary
Where a kids station is installed, review sight lines to the stop
comments: Install a low planting bed inside the roundabout to prevent accidents caused by driver blind spots when reversing
basis: Rule on Housing Construction Standards, Article 6 · Regulation on Housing Construction Standards, Article 26
checkpoints_ko: □ 통학차량 정차를 위해 주출입구 분리대 또는 회전교차로 설치
□ 일반차량과 통학차량의 동선 분리(화단 권장)
□ 통학차량 정류장 안내를 위한 바닥노면표시 및 표지판 설치
□ 횡단보도 설치부위 정류장 계획 금지
□ 필요시 반사경, 출차주의 등 안전시설 설치
□ 키즈스테이션 설치시 정류장 시야 확보 검토
comments_ko: 후진 시 운전자 사각지대에 의한 사고발생 예방을 위해 회전 교차로 내부는 낮은 화단 설치
basis_ko:
주택건설기준 등에 관한 규칙 제6조
주택건설기준 등에 관한 규정 제26조

drawing: Site layout plan / Building floor plan
item: Installation of falling-object protection at entrances
checkpoints: Residential tower piloti with open top, underground parking ramp: 1,000mm
Roof-level entrance door: 900mm
Residential tower entrance, outdoor stair: 600mm (at least 2 stair risers from the entrance)
comments: Design-driven planning may shorten the canopy projection in some areas, so review this in advance
basis: Design Guideline Article 14 (p. 22)
checkpoints_ko: □ 상부 오픈된 주동 필로티, 지하주차장 램프: 1,000mm
□ 지붕층 출입문 : 900mm
□ 주동출입구, 옥외계단 : 600mm (출입구로부터 계단 2단 이상)
comments_ko: 디자인 위주 계획으로 일부구간의 캐노피 내민길이가 부족해질 수 있으므로 사전에 검토

drawing: Site layout plan / DA (supply/exhaust vent) detail
item: Fall-prevention planning for above-ground structures
checkpoints: Plan fall prevention for above-ground structures such as top lights and D.A
(Fan room ventilation opening) Installing a safety railing on the inner side is recommended
(Underground parking ventilation opening) Install galvanized steel grating
(Underground parking ventilation opening) Install planting 1m or wider, or a safety fence or railing
comments: Do not use fall-prevention netting or wire; install steel grating
basis: Design Guideline Article 44 (p. 186) · Detail drawings DA83-401~404
checkpoints_ko: □ 탑라이트, DA 등 지상구조물 추락방지 계획
□ (휀룸 환기구) 내부측 안전난간 설치 권장
□ (지하주차장 환기구) 아연도 철제그레이팅으로 설치
□ (지하주차장 환기구) 조경식재(폭 1m 이상) 또는 안전펜스, 난간 설치
comments_ko: 추락방지용 그물망 및 와이어로 계획 금지하고 철제그레이팅으로 설치

item: Prohibition of structures in front of lower-floor dwelling units
checkpoints: Avoid placing D.A in front of the units
Avoid placing the household resource storage in front of the units
Avoid placing other facilities such as bicycle storage in front of the units
comments: Review relocating these facilities to the side or rear so that they do not obstruct views from lower-floor units
other: Use piloti space for outdoor bicycle storage where possible
checkpoints_ko: □ D.A 전면부 배치 지양
□ 생활자원보관소 전면부 배치 지양
□ 자전거보관소 등 기타시설물 전면부 배치 지양
comments_ko: 시설물들은 측면이나 후면으로 이동 배치하여 저층세대 시야방해 안되도록 검토
other_ko: 옥외 자전거보관소는 가급적 필로티 공간을 활용

drawing: Site layout plan / Exterior stair plan and section
item: Confirmation of the outdoor elevator installation plan
checkpoints: Install a canopy above the landing and partitions at the sides
Raise the entrance floor by 15cm and finish it with flame-textured granite
For accessibility, provide a ramp of 1/12 or flatter and tactile dot blocks
Use tempered glass 12mm or thicker from handrail height for the glazing that provides the car's outward view
comments: Reinforce the detail drawings, including the tempered glass of the car
basis: Housing Design Division 1-4387 ('10.12.22.) · LHCS 31 55 05 15 Observation elevator
checkpoints_ko: □ 승강장 상부에 캐노피와 측부에 칸막이 설치
□ 출입구 바닥 높이 15cm 높이고 화강석버너구이 마감
□ 장애인 편의를 위해 경사로는 1/12 이상 및 점형블록 계획
□ 승강카의 외부조망용 유리는 수평손잡이 높이부터 두께 12mm 이상 강화유리 사용
comments_ko: 승강카 강화유리 등 상세도 보강

item: Plan to secure access lanes for moving trucks
checkpoints: Secure access lanes for moving trucks, considering units that will not use a ladder truck (secure a lane 4m wide, at least 3m, up to the residential tower entrance)
comments: Plan the access road width considering the 2.3m cargo bed width of a 5-ton truck
checkpoints_ko:
□ 사다리차 미이용 세대 감안하여 이사차량 접근차로 확보
    (주동 출입구까지 폭 4m(최소 3m 이상) 차로 확보)
comments_ko: 5톤 화물차 기준 적재함 너비 2.3m 감안하여 접근도로폭 계획

item: Installation of traffic safety facilities around the underground parking ramp
checkpoints: Plan traffic safety facilities such as vehicle-exit warning signs at the ramp entrance
Provide a buffer zone where the underground parking garage merges onto the above-ground road
Install safety facilities including convex mirrors, speed humps and pavement markings (stop line)
comments: Separate the exit from the above-ground road with curbs, landscaping and similar measures so that vehicles do not merge directly onto the road
checkpoints_ko: □ 램프입구에 '출차주의 등' 교통안전시설 계획
□ 지하주차장에서 지상도로 합류부위 완충구간 적용
□ 반사경, 과속방지턱, 노면표시(정지선) 등 안전시설 설치
comments_ko: 지상으로 차량이 출차시 지상도로와 합류가 안되도록 조경 등 경계석 구분계획

item: Underground parking ramp layout plan
checkpoints: Avoid locating the ramp entrance in front of dwelling units
Use landscaping and similar measures to prevent complaints about headlight light pollution and alarm noise
comments: Also for deck parking access, check the vehicle circulation route and take measures so that lower-floor units are not affected by vehicle entry
checkpoints_ko: □ 세대 전면에 램프 출입구 배치 지양
□ 전조등 빛공해, 경보기 소음 민원 방지를 위해 조경 등 처리
comments_ko: 데크주차장 진입시에도 차량 진입에 의해 저층 세대 피해 없도록 차얄동선 확인 후 조치

item: Underground interference in urban construction planning
checkpoints: Offset underground structures at least 1m from the adjacent lot boundary
Design underground structures in consideration of constructability and interference with adjacent buildings
comments: When reviewing the site layout plan, check the adjacent lot boundary to identify and address issues in advance
checkpoints_ko: □ 지하구조물 설계시 인접대지 경계선에서 1m 이상 이격
□ 작업 시공성, 인접건물 간섭 등 감안하여 지하구조물 설계
comments_ko: 단지배치도 검토시 인접대지 경계선 확인하여 문제점 사전 파악 조치

item: Site planning in consideration of earth retaining and excavation
checkpoints: Apply conventional earth retaining methods such as H-beam with timber lagging or earth anchors
Do not use earth anchors where the area outside the site is another use
Install rakers toward the inside of the site
Prevent interference between rakers and underground structures
Where rakers inevitably interfere with underground structures, coordinate across the architectural, civil and structural disciplines to minimize section loss and damage to waterproofing
checkpoints_ko: □ H빔-토류판 또는 어스앵커 등 일반적인 흙막이 공법 적용
□ 단지 외부가 타용지인 경우 어스앵커 사용 금지
□ 경사버팀대(Raker)는 단지 내부로 설치
□ 경사버팀대와 지하구조물 간섭 방지

□ 경사버팀대가 지하구조물과 불가피하게 간섭될 경우 단면결손, 방수훼손 등 최소화를
    위해 건축, 토목, 구조 공종간 협업

drawing: Site layout plan / Composite design drawing
item: Appropriateness of the stormwater handling plan
checkpoints: Confirm the final stormwater routing from buildings and do not route stormwater pipes along pedestrian paths
Review slopes and trenches so that standing water does not occur
Review the suitability of stormwater trench locations (apartment buildings, auxiliary welfare facilities, etc.)
comments: Check the slope and trench plan at auxiliary building entrances and prevent stormwater from flowing in via reverse slope
checkpoints_ko: □ 건물 우수처리 동선 최종루트 확인하여 보행동선에 우수관 설치 계획 금지
□ 상시 물고임 발생되지 않도록 구배 및 트렌치 계획 검토
□ 우수처리 트렌치 설치부위 적정성 검토(아파트, 부대복리시설 등)
comments_ko: 부대동 진입부 구배 및 트렌치 계획 확인하고 역구배로 우수유입되지 않도록 계획

item: Confirmation of level markings and suitability at level differences
checkpoints: Mark levels on slopes and at level differences
Where a height difference occurs, secure the slope setback distance (confirm slope setback, landscape rock stacking, etc.)
comments: Beyond the main entrance, identify sections where stormwater could flow from the road into the site, and review installing flood barriers and upsizing drainage channels where necessary
item_ko: 단차부위 레벨 표기 및 적정성 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ 경사지 및 단차부위 레벨 표기
□ 높이 차이가 발생할 경우 사면 이격거리 확보(사면 이격거리, 조경석쌓기 등 확인)
comments_ko: 주출입구 외에도 도로에서 단지내로 우수유입 가능구간 확인하고, 필요시 물막이 설치 및 배수로 규격 상향 등 검토

drawing: Site layout plan / Auxiliary facility plan
item: Appropriateness of neighborhood living facility planning
checkpoints: Plan a household resource storage for residents only in the neighborhood living facility
Provide a clear corridor width of 1,200mm or more and install a ramp where floor level differences occur
Provide at least 1 accessible parking space
Take measures such as planting to block noise and odors and for landscaping
Install an access opening and inspection ladder below the 1st-floor restroom
Provide a clear pit height of 1,800mm or more and a clear passage of 1,200mm or more
comments: Items that cannot be confirmed on the site layout plan shall be reviewed with reference to the auxiliary facility design drawings
basis: Design Guideline (Architecture) Article 33 (p. 162)
checkpoints_ko: □ 근린생활시설 입주자 전용 생활자원보관소 계획
□ 복도 유효폭은 1,200mm 이상으로 하고 바닥 단차발생시 경사로 설치
□ 장애인 전용주차장 1대 이상 계획
□ 소음․악취의 차단과 조경을 위한 식재 등 조치
□ 1층 화장실 하부에 점검구 및 점검용 사다리 설치
□ 피트의 유효높이 1,800mm이상, 유효통로 1,200mm 이상
comments_ko: 단지배치도상확인불가항목들은부대시설설계도면참고하여검토

drawing: Site layout plan / Building floor plan / Core floor plan
item: Confirmation of slopes (gradient, pitch) by location
checkpoints: Ramp [residential tower entrance: 1/12 (housing vulnerable: 1/18), auxiliary welfare facilities: 1/12]
Roof [pitched roof: 4/10, flat roof: 1/50~1/150]
Dwelling unit [bathroom: 1/100, balcony: 1/150]
Common area [corridor: 1/150]
Underground [underground parking garage: confirm adequate slope where trenches are installed]
basis: Roof — Design Guideline Article 17 (pp. 101, 102) · Corridor, entrance — Design Guideline Article 14 (pp. 41, 20) · Bathroom — Design Guideline Article 15 (p. 51) · Auxiliary welfare — Design Guideline Article 26 (p. 131)
checkpoints_ko: □ 경사로 [주동 출입구: 1/12(주거약자: 1/18), 부대복리시설: 1/12]
□ 지하 [지하주차장: 트렌치 설치시 적정구배 확인]
basis_ko:
지붕-설계지침 제17조(101,102쪽)
복도,출입구-설계지침 제14조(41쪽,20쪽)
욕실-설계지침 제15조(51쪽)
부대복리-설계지침 제26조(131쪽)

item: Confirmation of drawing consistency between disciplines at key locations
checkpoints: Confirm consistency among architectural, structural, civil, landscape and electrical drawings at key locations
Compare the structural frame with the design member sizes
Confirm whether structural calculations account for the landscaping soil depth
Confirm consistency between exterior drawings and electrical drawings for side walls, gate posts, building entrances and basement connecting passages
checkpoints_ko: □ 주요부위의 건축, 구조, 토목, 조경, 전기 등 정합성 확인
□ 골조와 설계 부재 크기 비교
□ 조경 토심을 감안한 구조계산 반영 여부 확인
□ 측벽, 문주, 동출입구, 지하층 연결통로 등 익스테리어 도면과 전기도면 정합성 확인

item: Ensuring equity with adjacent sites in the same district
checkpoints: Confirm that separate survey data such as the total design study has been prepared and submitted
Extent of stone finishes, stone type, landscape lighting, railing material outside the site
Confirm finishes at the main entrance, storage space by balcony unit type (shoe cabinet, built-in closet, etc.), options, etc.
comments: Plan in advance so that differences in design and finishes between sites in the district do not generate complaints
item_ko: 동일 지구 내 인접단지 형평성 확보
checkpoints_ko: □ 토탈디자인 등 별도 조사자료 작성 및 제출 확인
□ 석재마감 범위, 석종, 경관조명, 단지외부 난간재질
□ 주현관부위 마감, 발코니 평형별 수납공간(신발장, 반침 등), 옵션 등 확인
comments_ko: 지구내 단지별 설계 및 마감 차이가 발생되어 민원이 발생되지 않도록 사전에 계획

drawing: Fire compartment plan / Building floor plan
item: Confirmation of whether fire compartment drawings have been prepared
checkpoints: Prepare separate detail drawings, including a fire compartment plan for each building
Indicate fire compartments including fire doors, automatic fire shutters and fire dampers
Indicate the egress distance from the living room to the fire door
comments: For apartment buildings, confirm an egress distance of 40m, or 50m for buildings of 16 stories or more
basis: Design Guideline (Architecture) Article 11 (p. 7)
checkpoints_ko: □ 각 동 방화구획 평면도 등 상세도 별도 작성
□ 방화문, 자동방화셔터, 방화댐퍼 등 방화구획 표기
□ 거실에서 방화문까지 피난거리 표기
comments_ko: 아파트의 경우 피난거리는 40m, 16층 이상인 경우 50m 확인

item: Confirmation of the final area calculation table
checkpoints: Review the calculation formulas and values, and verify in CAD where necessary
Confirm that the figures in the area calculation table match the dwelling unit floor plans
basis: Design Guideline (Architecture) Article 22 (p. 127)
checkpoints_ko: □ 산정식 및 산정값 검토하고 필요시 캐드로 확인
□ 면적산출표의 그림과 단위세대 평면도와 일치여부 확인

drawing: Interior finish schedule / Main entrance plan
item: Design standard for common-area floor finishes
checkpoints: Indoor common-area floor finish: honed granite (residential tower above-ground entrance lobby, basement connecting passage, EV hall, public buildings, auxiliary facilities, etc.)
basis: Housing Innovation Office-1483 (2025.04.15.)
checkpoints_ko:
□ 실내 공용부위 바닥마감재: 화강석 혼드마감 적용
     (주동 지상출입구 전실, 지하연결통로, EV홀, 공공건축물, 부대시설 등)

item: Finishes specified for stairwell walls and baseboards
checkpoints: Delete the resin plaster specification on stairwell walls where aluminum (AL) formwork is applied
Apply resin plaster to the wall where the elevator is installed in the EV hall
Where concrete surfaces receive a paint finish, specify 'baseboard paint' (do not use cove base paint)
basis: In preparation for defect litigation · Customer Quality Innovation Team-6399 ('20.12.10) · Customer Quality Innovation Team-4381 ('20.09.07) · DA-70-107~109
item_ko: 계단실 벽체 및 걸레받이 마감재 표기
checkpoints_ko: □ AL폼이 적용된 계단실 벽체에 수지미장 표기 삭제
□ EV홀 승강기가 설치된 벽면은 수지미장 적용
□ 콘크리트면에 도장마감시 '걸레받이용 페인트'로 표기 (굽도리 페인트 금지)

item: Confirmation of finishes in the basement EV hall and connecting passage
checkpoints: (Ceiling) Light-gauge steel ceiling frame + color aluminum ceiling panel
(Wall) Apply materials such as multicolor pattern paint or porcelain tile that resist condensation and moisture, are easy to maintain and provide fire performance
basis: Housing Innovation Office-1483 (2025.04.15.)
item_ko: 지하층 EV홀 및 연결통로 마감재 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ (천장) 경량철골 천장틀+칼라 알루미늄 천장판

□ (벽체) 다채무늬도료 또는 포셀린타일 등 결로 및 습기에 강하고 유지관리 용이하며
                  방화성능 확보 자재 적용

drawing: Interior finish schedule / Seasonal storage section
item: Confirmation of the ceiling finish standard for seasonal storage
checkpoints: (Ceiling) Interior water-based paint on concrete, or THK10 inorganic spray coating on insulation areas
(Wall) Interior water-based paint on concrete
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-6399 ('20.12.10)
checkpoints_ko: □ (천장) 콘크리트 위 내부수성페인트 또는 단열재 부위 THK10 무기질계뿜칠
□ (벽체) 콘크리트 위 내부수성페인트

drawing: Interior finish schedule / Core floor plan
item: Confirmation of the ceiling finish standard for elevator halls
checkpoints: (1st floor) Light-gauge steel ceiling frame + color aluminum ceiling panel

(2nd floor and above) Concrete substrate + multicolor pattern paint (if SP piping unavoidably passes through the elevator hall because of the AV room layout, apply light-gauge steel ceiling frame + 1 layer of THK12.5 gypsum board + joint treatment + multicolor pattern paint)
comments: If SP piping is exposed along only part of the corridor, for-sale housing cannot easily vary the ceiling finish, so apply the light-gauge steel ceiling frame + gypsum board throughout
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-5236 ('22.12.05) · Customer Quality Innovation Team-6539 ('20.12.16) · Customer Quality Innovation Team-7891 ('19.12.23)
checkpoints_ko: □ (1층) 경량철골 천장틀+칼라알루미늄 천장판

□ (2층 이상) 콘크리트 바탕면+다채무늬 도료
                      (부득이 AV실 계획으로 SP배관이 승강기홀을 지나는 경우, 경량철골천장틀
                       +THK12.5 석고보드 1겹+이음부처리+다채무늬 도료 적용)
comments_ko: SP배관이 복도에 일부구간만 노출될 경우, 분양주택은 천장마감을 달리하기 어려워 전체 경량철골천정틀+석고보드로 반영

drawing: Interior finish schedule / Insulation and waterproofing detail
item: Verify bathroom wall waterproofing finish criteria
checkpoints: Masonry wall areas: cement liquid waterproofing or polymer-based waterproofing + tile adhesive mortar + ceramic tile
Bathroom waterproofing on masonry walls up to H=1200mm; shower stall wall side up to H=1800mm
Where the bathroom wall is concrete, delete wall waterproofing
comments: When wall waterproofing is deleted, also delete cement liquid waterproofing (or polymer-based waterproofing, H=1200mm or less) and 8mm tile adhesive mortar (from H=1200mm up to ceiling +100mm)
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-6959 ('18.12.20) · DA-15-308, 309
checkpoints_ko: □ 조적벽 부위에 시멘트 액체방수 or 폴리머계방수+타일붙임 모르타르+도기질 타일
□ 조적벽의 욕실 방수는 H=1200mm 이하, 샤워부스 벽쪽 H=1800mm
□ 욕실 벽체가 콘크리트 벽체인 경우 벽체용 방수 삭제
comments_ko: 벽체용 방수 삭제시 시멘트 액체방수(또는 폴리머계방수, H=1200mm 이하) 및 타일붙임 모르타르 8mm(H=1200mm이상~천장+100mm까지) 삭제

drawing: Interior finish schedule / Dwelling unit floor plan
item: Verify finish criteria at kitchen cabinet installation areas
checkpoints: (Base cabinet floor) Apply water-based paint (interior grade) up to the cabinet end line at base cabinet locations, and note on the drawing that flooring (sheet carpet/hardwood plywood floor) is installed 100mm inward from the cabinet end line
(Base cabinet wall) Omit finish material on walls at kitchen cabinet locations, and note on the drawing that kitchen wall tile is installed 100mm inward from the end of the base cabinet rear shelf
Base cabinet toe kick: note on the drawing that it is installed 60mm inward from the cabinet end line
basis: Housing Technology Division-5545 ('22.11.17)
checkpoints_ko:
□ (하부장 바닥) 하부장 설치부위는 가구 끝선까지 수성페인트(내부용) 시공하고 바닥재
    (륨카펫/강화합판마루)는 하부장 끝선에서 안쪽 100mm까지 시공하도록 도면 표기

□ (하부장 벽체) 주방가구 설치부위 벽면은 마감재 시공 제외 + 주방벽 타일은 하부장
                            뒷선반 끝에서 안쪽 100mm까지 시공하도록 도면 표기
□ 하부장 걸레받이 : 주방가구 끝선에서 안쪽 60mm까지 시공하도록 도면 표기

item: Secure fire-resistive structure in the wall beside the unit entrance fire door frame
checkpoints: (Stair-access type) Mortar pack between fire door frame (unit entrance door, refuge area, etc.) and structural frame
(Corridor-access type) Urethane foam pack between general door frame (condensation-resistant unit entrance door, etc.) and structural frame
Provide 100mm wall thickness beside the fire door frame and apply fire gasket
Indoor side: install gypsum board furring, then apply 15X15 square sealant
Outdoor side: apply 10X10 triangular sealant
Refuge area and common areas: apply 10X10 triangular sealant on both indoor and outdoor sides
comments: Fire doors in stair-access apartments must have fire gaskets installed; corridor-access apartments use EPDM gaskets
basis: DA-96-513 · Housing Technology Division-598 ('19.3.4) · Customer Quality Innovation Group-7891 ('19.12.23)
item_ko: 세대 현관 방화문틀 옆 벽체 내화구조 확보
checkpoints_ko: □ (계단식) 방화문(세대현관문, 대피공간 등) 문틀과 골조 사이 모르타르 사춤
□ (복도식) 일반문(결로방지형 세대현관문 등) 문틀과 골조 사이 우레탄폼 사춤
□ 방화문 문틀 옆 벽체 벽두께 100mm 확보하고 방화용 가스켓 적용
□ 실내측은 석고보드 띄움 후 15X15 사각실링 적용
□ 실외측은 10X10 삼각실링 적용
□ 대피공간 및 공용부위는 실내외측 모두 10X10 삼각실링 적용
comments_ko: 계단식 아파트 방화문에는 반드시 방화용 가스켓을 설치하고 복도식 아파트는 EPDM 가스켓을 적용

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Dwelling unit window schedule
item: Verify unit entrance door performance
checkpoints: (Corridor type) Condensation resistance + airtightness
(Stair-core type) Condensation resistance + fire resistance + smoke control + airtightness
basis: LHCS 41 55 06 Steel windows and doors
checkpoints_ko: □ (복도형) 결로방지성능 + 기밀성
□ (계단실형) 결로방지성능 + 방화성능 + 차연성능 + 기밀성

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Main section / Waterproofing and insulation detail
item: Plan flanking resilient layer for inter-floor noise
checkpoints: Flanking resilient layer thickness 10mm or more
Show the flanking resilient layer on all walls so the finish mortar does not contact walls directly
Install continuously at flanking areas in contact with the ondol floor, such as masonry walls, load-bearing walls, and living room PL window frames
Do not install at door frame bottoms (support block installation) or entrance door areas
checkpoints_ko: □ 측면완충재 두께는 10mm 이상 적용
□ 마감 모르타르가 벽에 직접 닿지 않도록 모든 벽면에 시공하도록 측면완충재 표기
□ 조적벽, 내력벽, 거실 PL창호 문틀 등 온돌바닥과 접하는 측면부위 연속 설치
□ 문틀하부(고임대 설치) 및 현관출입문 부위 등은 부착하지 않음

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Main section / Waterproofing and insulation detail
item: Apply Grade 2 inter-floor noise technology
checkpoints: (110mm floor structure) Composite resilient layer 30 + general mortar 40 + general mortar 40 (composite resilient layer, thermal conductivity 0.036 W/m·K or less)
Meet the thermal transmittance criterion of 0.810 W/m·K for heated inter-floor slabs
(Structural design) Where general mortar is substituted, reflect the increased unit weight in the structural design
comments: Where lightweight foamed concrete is applied, use the 0.6-grade quality standard, and 0.5 grade in Central Region 1
basis: Smart Housing Technology Division-1299 ('25.03.28)
checkpoints_ko:
□ (110mm 바닥구조) 복합완충재 30 + 일반몰탈 40 + 일반몰탈 40
                                     (복합완충재, 열전도율 0.036 W/m·K 이하)
□ 바닥난방인 층간바닥의 열관류율 기준 0.810 W/m·K 충족
□ (구조설계) 일반몰탈 대체 시 단위중량 증가 반영하여 구조설계
comments_ko: 경량기포 적용될 경우 품질기준 0.6품 적용하되, 중부1 지역은 0.5품 적용

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior finish schedule / Window detail
item: Verify adequacy of unit bathroom door planning
checkpoints: Plan so the door leaf does not conflict with the toilet when the bathroom door is opened/closed (also review when a bidet is installed)
Bathroom door size: change 7X21/D to 8X21/D
Finish: decorative sheet over ABS
comments: Where the highest building in the complex is 16 storeys or more, install door finger-pinch guards on bathroom doors (2 indoor faces)
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-4381 ('20.09.07) · Public Housing Planning Division-2274 (2022.06.22.)
checkpoints_ko: □ 욕실문 개폐 시 문짝과 변기 간섭되지 않도록 계획(비데 설치할 경우도 검토)
□ 욕실문 규격 : 7X21/D → 8X21/D 적용
□ 마감은 ABS위 데코시트 적용
comments_ko: 단지내 최고층수 16층 이상이면 욕실문 손끼임 방지장치 설치 (실내 2면)

item: Plan same-storey piping space for system bathroom
checkpoints: Prefabricated bathrooms in public rental housing shall use same-storey wall piping
Install semi-one-piece wall-drain water closet
Bathroom slab thickness 150mm with 90mm slab down
Slab width at the step offset bend shall be 315mm or more (400mm recommended)
Provide 180mm or more clearance from the UBR wall end to the inside face of the lightweight partition
Provide waterproof board width of 1500mm or more to avoid conflict between the water closet and door
comments: Same-storey wall piping does not require a fire-stop filling structure, so there is no need to change to wet construction
basis: Public Housing Facilities Division-6860 ('24.11.12)
checkpoints_ko: □ 공공임대의 조립식욕실은 당해층 벽면배관 방식 적용
□ 준원피스형 벽배수용 양변기 설치
□ 욕실 슬래브두께는 150mm 적용하고 90mm 슬래브 다운 적용
□ 단차구간 꺾임부 슬래브 폭은 315mm 이상 확보(400mm 권장)
□ UBR벽체끝에서 경량벽체 안쪽까지 공간이 180mm 이상 공간 확보
□ 양변기와 도어간섭 없도록 방수판 규격 1500mm 이상 확보
comments_ko: 당해층 벽면배관 적용시 내화채움구조는 불필요하므로 습식공사로 변경할 필요 없음

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Main section / Waterproofing and insulation detail
item: Review bathroom ceiling insulation and condensation
checkpoints: Typical floor bathrooms shall be heated, with THK35 insulation installed under the slab (delete ceiling condensation-prevention material in bathrooms with insulation)
System bathrooms shall be unheated, with no insulation installed
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-7891 ('19.12.23) · Design Guideline (Architecture) Article 15 (p.59)
item_ko: 욕실 천장 단열 및 결로 검토
checkpoints_ko:
□ 기준층 욕실은 난방적용하며 슬라브 하부에 THK35 단열재 설치
    (단열재 설치하는 욕실의 천장 결로방지재 삭제)
□ 시스템 욕실은 비난방으로 하고 단열재 설치하지 않음

item: Verify adequacy of bathroom shower stall planning
checkpoints: Check interference of the shower stall door leaf with the faucet and handle when opening/closing
Plan the shower area 900*900mm or larger
Where the shower area is 900*900mm or less, install the partition only (delete the door leaf)
Shower stall glass: laminated glass THK 8.76 or more, Class II-1 or II-2
Apply floor coil heating to the shower stall as well
Prepare a shower area step detail and note the shower stall glass (raised installation)
Install 1 floor drain trench in the bathroom
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-2029 (2018.04.24) · Housing Technology Division-2166 ('18.06.11) · Housing Technology Division-3741 ('15.10.16.) · Design Guideline (Architecture) Article 15 (p.61) · DA-92-015
checkpoints_ko: □ 샤워부스 문짝 개폐시 수전, 손잡이 간섭 확인
□ 샤워공간 900*900mm 이상으로 계획
□ 샤워공간 900*900mm 이하 시 샤워부스 칸막이만 설치(문짝 삭제)
□ 샤워부스 유리는 THK 8.76 이상 접합유리 II-1류 또는 II-2류 적용
□ 샤워부스도 바닥코일난방 적용
□ 샤워공간 단차 상세도 작성 및 샤워부스  유리 표기(띄움시공)
□ 욕실 내 배수트렌치 1개소 설치

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (bathroom, living room, etc.)
item: Verify adequacy of tile planning at dissimilar-material joints
checkpoints: Avoid designing dissimilar materials (concrete + masonry/lightweight partition) on bathroom walls, art walls, etc.
Plan dissimilar-material joints on the tile layout S.P (Start Point) grid
Install movement joints at crack-prone locations (dissimilar-material joints, S.P locations) to prevent cracking
comments: Tile cracking occurs from minor shrinkage and movement of the substrate at joints between dissimilar materials such as masonry and concrete, so install movement joints (caulking, etc.) and reflect them in the S.P
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-5235 (21.12.02)
item_ko: 이질재 접합부 타일 계획 적정성 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ 욕실벽 및 아트월 등 이질재(콘크리트+조적/경량벽체) 설계 지양
□ 이질재 접합부위를 타일나누기 S.P(Start Point) 기준으로 계획
□ 균열이 생기기 쉬운 부분(이질재 접합부, S.P 부위)은 균열방지를 위해 신축줄눈 설치
comments_ko: 조적+콘크리트 등 이질재 접합부 바탕면의 미세한 수축 및 거동으로 타일 균열 발생되므로 신축줄눈(코킹 등) 설치하고 S.P 반영

item: Minimize masonry walls
checkpoints: Minimize masonry walls and use reinforced concrete
Avoid short wall segments at door frame wing walls (bathroom and bedroom doors, hinge side)
Delete the 80mm masonry soldier-course wall at door corners
Apply door stoppers to prevent door lock interference
comments: Masonry work risks schedule delay and quality loss due to the shortage of skilled workers, so change to structural concrete where possible
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-6959 ('18.12.20)
checkpoints_ko: □ 조적벽체 계획은 최소화 하고 철근콘크리트 적용
□ 문틀 날개벽(욕실 및 침실문, 경첩부위) 짧은 벽체 없도록 계획
□ 문 코너부위 이격거리 80㎜ 조적세워쌓기 삭제
□ 도어록 간섭이 없도록 도어스토퍼 적용
comments_ko: 조적공사 기능공 부족 등으로 공정지연 및 품질저하 발생 우려되므로 가급적 골조로 변경

item: Reinforcement plan for living room lightweight partition
checkpoints: Note steel plate reinforcement locations on the drawing where heavy items such as TVs are installed on lightweight partitions
Place 1.2mm thick, 300~600mm steel plate between base gypsum board and finish gypsum board, fixed with studs for reinforcement
No separate reinforcement required for concrete walls
comments: When installing an air conditioner or wall-mounted TV on a lightweight partition, note steel plate reinforcement locations on the drawing in accordance with the specification
other: Notify residents in advance through the resident guide of reinforcement locations for fixture installation and the related installation methods
basis: LHCS 41 51 04 05 Gypsum board composite panel
checkpoints_ko: □ 경량벽체에 TV 등 중량물 설치 시 철판보강 위치 도면 표기

□ 두께 1.2mm, 300~600mm 철판을 바탕석고보드와 마감석고보드 사이에 두고
     스터드로 고정하여 보강
□ 콘크리트 벽일 경우 별도 보강 불필요
comments_ko: 경량벽체에 에어컨 또는 벽걸이 TV 설치시 시방서에 의거하여 철판보강 위치 도면 표기
other_ko: 부착물 설치를 위한 보강부위 및 부착물 설치방법 등에 관한 사항은 입주자 안내문을 통해 사전 고지

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Building floor plan
item: Verify adequacy of main apartment floor plan
checkpoints: Avoid excessive facade projections and recesses when planning the unit floor plan
Ensure the east-side balcony does not set back excessively compared with the west side of the front facade
Show the entire plan at side walls, staggered units, and mixed configurations where different unit types are adjacent
comments: Reflect the residential tower elevation design in the facade, while avoiding excessive projections and recesses so as to secure good sunlight and daylight
basis: Design Guideline Article 15 (p.51)
item_ko: 주요 아파트 평면도 계획 적정성 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ 단위세대 평면도 계획 시 지나친 외관 요철 지양
□ 전면부 서측 부위보다 동측 발코니측이 지나치게 set-back되지 않도록
□ 측벽부위 및 엇갈림, 다른타입 인접 등 이형조합 부위 전체 평면도 표현
comments_ko: 외관은 주동입면의 디자인을 고려하되 양호한 일조, 채광이 가능하도록 지나친 요철 지양

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (kitchen cabinets)
item: Secure clearance between kitchen cooktop and wall
checkpoints: (Rental) 150mm or more from the wall (except where the total kitchen cabinet length is less than 2,500mm)
(For-sale) 150mm or more from the tiled wall
(For-sale) 300mm or more from the finished face of the cabinet side panel
comments: Avoid designing a PL window behind the cooktop to prevent window deformation from heat
basis: Design Guideline Article 15 (p.57) · Customer Quality Innovation Group-4354 ('20.09.04)
checkpoints_ko: □ (임대) 벽면에서 150mm 이상 이격 (단, 주방가구 전체 길이 2,500mm 미만 시 예외)
□ (분양) 타일이 붙는 벽면에서 150mm 이상 이격
□ (분양) 가구측판 마감면에서 300mm 이상 이격
comments_ko: 열기에 의한 창호 변형 방지를 위해 주방가열대 후면 PL창호 설계 지양

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (kitchen cabinets)
item: Secure clearance between sink drainboard and cooktop
checkpoints: (Basic) 500mm or more recommended
(Rental) 400mm or more
(For-sale) 600mm or more (450mm or more for L-shaped cabinets)
basis: Technical Standards Division-5780 ('12.12.27.)
checkpoints_ko: □ (기본) 500㎜ 이상 권장
□ (임대) 400㎜ 이상 확보
□ (분양) 600㎜ 이상 확보 ('ㄱ'자형 가구의 경우 450㎜이상)

item: Verify kitchen lighting switch location
checkpoints: Review the installation location of the network switch for kitchen and dining lighting
Lighting switches cannot be installed on the refrigerator cabinet side panel, so relocate them to a wall such as a lightweight partition
Switches cannot be installed on cabinet side panels such as the refrigerator cabinet
Install switches on lightweight partitions 145mm or more thick
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-3130 ('20.07.08)
checkpoints_ko: □ 주방, 식탁 조명용 네트워크 스위치 설치 위치 검토
□ 조명용 스위치는 냉장고장 측판에 설치 불가하므로 경량벽체 등 벽체쪽으로 이동
□ 냉장고장 등 가구 측판에 스위치 설치 불가
□ 두께 145mm이상 경량벽체에 스위치 설치

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (kitchen cabinets)
item: Review kitchen drain location
checkpoints: Do not install the drain at the center of the sink; offset it
Connect by the shortest route and plan so that no sag develops in the drain pipe
checkpoints_ko: □ 싱크대 중앙에 배수구 설치 금지, 편차 배치
□ 최단거리로 연결, 배수관 고임부위 발생 치 않도록 계획

item: Review adequacy of small window sizes
checkpoints: Consider opening/closing defects when planning small windows in kitchens, dressing rooms, balconies, etc.
Recommended height-to-width ratio per 1 window sash: 2.5 or less
comments: The ratio applies per 1 window sash, i.e. 1/2 of the width; recommended dimensions are dressing room BPW 10*12 and balcony window BP 9*10
other: Consider interference with system shelf storage when reviewing dressing room windows
item_ko: 작은 창호 크기 계획 적정여부 검토
checkpoints_ko: □ 주방, 드레스룸, 발코니 등 작은 창호 계획시 개폐불량 하자 고려
□ 1개 창짝 기준 세로-가로비는 2.5 이하 권장
comments_ko: 1개 창짝 기준이므로 가로길이의 1/2 적용하며 드레스룸 BPW 10*12, 발코니창 BP 9*10 권장
other_ko: 드레스룸 창호 검토시 시스템선반 수납과 간섭 고려

item: Verify adequacy of laundry room door planning
checkpoints: Plan a turning door W=900mm or more for taking the washing machine in and out (9*21PD)
Effective clear width of the entrance door (PD, turning door) shall be W=710mm excluding the leaf and frame
Opening direction shall be toward the balcony by default, and toward the interior where not possible
comments: Dimension to the inside of the door frame so that the 710mm effective clear width can be verified precisely
basis: Housing Technology Division-2112 ('20.06.25) · Design Guideline Article 15 (p.71)
checkpoints_ko: □ 세탁기 반출입을 위해 W=900mm 이상 터닝도어 계획 (9*21PD)
□ 출입문(PD, 터닝도어) 유효폭은 문짝, 문틀제외 W=710㎜ 확보
□ 열림방향은 발코니쪽을 기본으로 하고 불가시 실내방향
comments_ko: 실유효폭 710mm 가 정확히 확인될 수 있도록 문틀 안쪽에 치수 표기

item: Verify adequacy of balcony washing machine installation planning
checkpoints: Minimum effective balcony width 1000mm or more, considering the downspout
Where less than 1000mm, plan the downspout etc. behind the washing machine
Washing machine pad: 800mm wide, 1000mm deep or more
Individual heating (boiler installation): add 1000mm + 300mm or more in depth
Where a separate laundry area is partitioned within the unit, apply PVC ceiling finish
comments: If the drain is located at the end between the pad and the wall, drainage becomes difficult and causes complaints such as cleaning problems, so place the drain toward the front where possible and extend the pad to the wall at the rear
basis: Design Guideline Article 15 (p.69)
item_ko: 발코니 세탁기 설치 계획 적정성 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ 발코니 최소 유효폭은 선홈통 고려 1000mm 이상 확보
□ 1000mm 미달시 선홈통 등은 세탁기 후면에 계획
□ 세탁기 설치 패드는 폭 800mm, 깊이 1000mm 이상으로 계획
□ 개별난방(보일러 설치)은 깊이 1000mm + 300mm 이상 추가
□ 세대 내에 세탁실 별도 구획시 PVC 천장재 마감 적용
comments_ko: 패드와 벽 사이 끝에 드레인이 위치할 경우 배수가 어려워 청소 등 민원 야기되므로 가급적 드레인은 앞쪽에 배치하고 안쪽은 패드가 벽까지 이어지도록 설치

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Main section
item: Condensation prevention plan for non-expanded balcony
checkpoints: Wall (Zones 1, 2): 30T bead-method Type 2 Class 2 EPS + 4.5T CRC board + interior water-based paint
Wall (Zone 3): 20T bead-method Type 2 Class 2 EPS + 4.5T CRC board + interior water-based paint
Ceiling: 15T extruded-method Class 1 XPS + 9.5T gypsum board + interior water-based paint
Refuge area and outdoor unit room interior walls and ceilings: interior water-based paint finish
comments: The 15T extruded-method Class 1 XPS on the ceiling is embedded in the concrete
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-3540 ('18.07.10) · DA60-101~106, 113, 122, 123
checkpoints_ko: □ 벽체(1,2구역) : 30T 비드법2종2호+4.5T CRC보드+내부수성페인트
□ 벽체(3구역) : 20T 비드법2종2호+4.5T CRC보드+내부수성페인트
□ 천장 : 15T 압출법1호+9.5T 석고보드+내부수성페인트
□ 대피공간, 실외기실 내부 벽체, 천장은 내부수성페인트 마감
comments_ko: 천정에 15T 압출법 1호는 콘크리트에 매립시공

item: Comply with balcony drain pipe design criteria
checkpoints: Install drain pipes on walls facing the interior to prevent freezing
Drain pipe diameter in non-expanded balconies: D100
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Group-885 ('18.02.27) · Customer Quality Innovation Group-3540 ('18.07.10)
checkpoints_ko: □ 동파방지를 위해 배수관은 실내측에 면한 벽에 설치
□ 비확장 발코니내 배수관 관경은 D100 적용

item: Verify balcony door opening direction
checkpoints: Opening direction of the non-expanded balcony folding door shall match that of the balcony window
checkpoints_ko: □ 비확장 발코니 분합문과 발코니 창호 개폐 방향 일치

item: Verify ABS resin vent planning
checkpoints: (Specification) ∅100 ABS resin, openable type
Install 1 unit each at the upper and lower parts of the wing walls of the front and rear balconies and refuge areas
Where a balcony boiler flue is installed, install only at the lower part of the wing wall
Also install in outdoor unit rooms with system louvers, except where the wall length is short
basis: Design Guideline (Architecture) p.106 · Customer Quality Innovation Group-1624 ('18.04.04) · Defect litigation
checkpoints_ko: □ (규격) ∅100 ABS수지, 개폐형
□ 전후면 발코니와 대피공간 날개벽 상하부 각 1개소 설치
□ 발코니 보일러 배기관 설치 시 날개벽 하부에만 설치
□ 시스템루버가 설치된 실외기실에도 설치하되 벽길이가 짧은 경우 제외

item: Comply with outdoor unit room design criteria
checkpoints: Secure clear space excluding the outdoor unit of 0.5m wide by 0.7m long
Plan so as not to interfere with the outdoor unit, faucets, drains, etc.
System louver: width 900mm or more, lower sill height 130mm or less
Districts with system air conditioning (for-sale, Newlywed Hope Town): outdoor unit size 950*330
Districts with system air conditioning (for-sale, Newlywed Hope Town): required outdoor unit room area 1,450*1,030 or more
comments: Determine the outdoor unit room area at the design stage in consideration of whether an outdoor unit is installed and its size
basis: Public Housing Equipment Division-1002 (2020.04.06) · Enforcement Rule of the Housing Construction Standards, Article 8
checkpoints_ko: □ 실외기를 제외한 여유공간 가로 0.5m, 세로 0.7m 확보
□ 실외기와 수전, 드레인 등 과 간섭되지 않도록 계획
□ 시스템루버는 가로폭 900mm 이상, 하부턱 높이 130mm 이하 계획
□ 시스템에어컨 적용 지구(분양, 신희타) : 실외기 크기 950*330
□ 시스템에어컨 적용 지구(분양, 신희타) : 실외기실 필요 면적 1,450 *1,030 이상
comments_ko: 설계단계에서 실외기 설치여부 및 크기 등 감안하여 실외기실 면적 산정
basis_ko:
공공주택설비처-1002(2020.04.06)
주택건설기준 등에 관한 규칙 제8조

item: Comply with downward evacuation opening design criteria
checkpoints: Plan the downward evacuation opening cover to open toward the wall (do not open toward the entrance door)
Do not plan downward evacuation openings in the lowest-floor unit (including simple representation)
Where a downward evacuation opening is installed in an outdoor unit room, apply an in-swing door toward the balcony or bedroom
Installation height: tile surface +30mm or more; apply urethane membrane waterproofing at the frame joint
comments: Where the lowest-floor unit of a downward evacuation route is not an evacuation floor, install an openable louver and a descent device so that evacuation is possible
other: Apply urethane membrane waterproofing (concealed) to prevent leakage
basis: Public Housing Equipment Division-1340 ('20.5.8) · Housing Technology Division-4739 ('20.12.30) · Design Guideline Article 15 (p.68)
checkpoints_ko: □ 하향식 피난구 덮개 열림방향 벽쪽으로 계획(출입문쪽 계획 금지)
□ 최하층 세대 하향식 피난구 계획 금지(단순 표현 포함)
□ 실외기실내 하향식 피난구 설치 시 발코니 혹은 침실 방향 안여닫이 적용
□ 설치높이 타일면 +30mm 이상, 골조 접합부에 우레탄 도막방수 적용
comments_ko: 하향식 피난 최하층 세대가 피난층이 아닌 경우 개폐형 루버와 완강기를 설치하여 대피가능토록 계획

item: Compliance with refuge area installation criteria
checkpoints: Install a refuge area where a unit on a floor of the 4th storey or higher in an apartment cannot use two or more direct stairs (not required on the 3rd storey or below / excluded where the party wall to the adjacent unit is an easily destructible lightweight structure and where a downward evacuation opening is installed)
(Area) 2㎡ or more where used separately by an individual unit / 3㎡ or more where shared with an adjacent unit
(Fire compartment) Provide as a fire compartment facing outside air and install a 60-minute+ fire door
basis: Enforcement Decree of the Building Act, Article 46, Paragraph 4 · Design Guideline Article 16 (p. 72)
checkpoints_ko:
□ 아파트 4층 이상인 층의 각 세대에서 2개 이상의 직통계단을 사용할 수 없는 경우 
     대피공간 설치 (3층이하 미설치 / 인접세대 경계벽 등 파괴하기 쉬운 경량 구조인 경우
     및 하향식피난구를 설치한 경우 설치 제외)
□ (면적) 개별세대 별도 사용할 경우 2㎡ 이상 / 인접세대 공동 사용할 경우 3㎡ 이상
□ (방화구획) 바깥외기에 접하는 방화구획으로 적용하고 60분+ 방화문 설치
basis_ko:
건축법 시행령 제46조 제4항
설계지침 제16조(72쪽)

item: Compliance with installation criteria for fire doors and exterior windows in refuge areas
checkpoints: For units with a refuge area on the 4th storey or higher, install a fire door (FSD) at the unit entrance and an inward-opening exterior window (PL)
Plan the fire door as an outward-opening type that swings toward the refuge area
Use a fire-rated door closer and 1.6T steel plate reinforcement on the fire door (horseshoe-type door stoppers not applied)
Plan the wall receiving the fire door in concrete (anchor installation and cracking of masonry walls)
Provide the exterior window insect screen as (type) roll type, (material) synthetic resin containing glass fiber
For 3rd-storey units equipped with a descent life line, install a steel window (SD) at the unit entrance and an inward-opening exterior window (PL)
For 1st–2nd storey units, install a steel window (SD) at the unit entrance and a sliding exterior window
basis: Housing Technology Office-4530 ('16.11.15) · Housing Technology Office-598 ('19.3.4) · Public Housing Project Office-1022 ('14.03.10) · Design Guideline Article 16 (p. 74) · DA-96-506 · DA-96-271
item_ko: 대피공간 방화문 및 외부창호 설치 기준 준수
checkpoints_ko: □ 4층이상 대피공간 설치 세대 출입문은 방화문(FSD), 안여닫이 외부창(PL) 설치
□ 방화문은 대피공간을 향해 열리는 밖여닫이 구조로 계획
□ 방화문에는 내화용 도어클로저, 철판보강 1.6T 사용(말발굽형 도어스토퍼는 미적용)
□ 방화문 설치 벽체는 콘크리트로 계획 (앙카설치, 조적별 크랙 문제)
□ 외부창의 방충망은 (형식) 롤방식, (재료) 유리섬유 함유된 합성수지제
□ 완강기 설치하는 3층 세대 출입문은 강제창호(SD), 안여닫이 외부창(PL) 설치
□ 1~2층 세대 출입문은 강제창호(SD), 미서기 외부창 설치

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Building floor plan / Piloti plan / Main section
item: Review of adequacy of insulation planning for dwelling units and piloti
checkpoints: Extend the insulation so that the unit exterior wall does not come into contact with the masonry wall
Design the in-unit insulation as a continuous layer without interruption to block cold bridges and thermal bridges
Apply exterior insulation to piloti walls to maintain structural continuity with the upper dwelling units (interior insulation)
Use phenolic foam for exterior-insulated areas such as the piloti ceiling and the underside of the 1st-floor slab of auxiliary facilities
comments: As exterior wall finishes must be non-combustible or quasi-non-combustible under the relevant regulations, install phenolic foam (PF board)
basis: Site Quality Management Team-4767 ('16.11.08) · Housing Technology Office-3489 (2018.09.12) · Design Guideline Article 17 (p. 92)
item_ko: 세대 및 필로티 등 단열재 계획 적정여부 검토
checkpoints_ko: □ 세대외벽과 조적벽체가 맞닿지 않도록 단열재 연장 시공
□ 세대내 단열재가 단절없이 연속으로 설계하여 냉교 및 열교 차단
□ 필로티 벽체는 상부 단위세대(내단열)와의 골조 일관성을 위해 외단열 적용
□ 필로티 천장, 부대시설 1층 슬래브 하부 등 외단열 부위는 페놀폼 계획
comments_ko: 관련 법규에 따라 외벽 마감재료는 불연 또는 준불연재료를 사용해야 하므로 페놀폼(PF보드)으로 설치

item: Verification of insulation planning by location, including exterior insulation
checkpoints: Where exterior insulation is applied at floor steps, extend the wall insulation down to below the floor insulation
Plan exterior insulation so that the insulation is not compromised by exterior wall finishes
Use non-combustible/quasi-non-combustible insulation such as phenolic foam for exterior insulation to prevent fire spread
comments: Connect insulation facing outside air without interruption; where it is interrupted, additionally install condensation-reduction material (450mm) to prevent cold bridges
other: Where a floor-step storey occurs, consider deleting unnecessary insulation for the lower units and supplying the upper units with a different exclusive floor area
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-5503 (2017.12.04) · DA-60-005 · DA-60-012 · DA-60-012-1
item_ko: 외단열 등 부위별 단열재 계획 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ 층단부위 외단열 시공시 벽단열재를 바닥단열재 하부까지 내림 시공
□ 외단열 계획시 외벽 마감 등으로 인해 단열재 결손되지 않도록 계획
□ 외단열 단열재는 화재 확산방지를 위해 페놀폼 등 불연/준불연단열재 사용
comments_ko: 외기에 면한 단열재는 끊기지 않도록 연결시키고 끊어지는 경우 냉교가 발생되지 않도록 결로저감재(450mm)를 추가 시공
other_ko: 층단차 발생층이 있을 경우 하부세대들의 불필요한 단열은 삭제하고 상부세대 전용면적을 달리하여 공급 검토

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Insulation detail
item: Verification of condensation reinforcement at exterior-wall pipe shaft (PD) locations
checkpoints: Install condensation-reduction material where a recessed niche (banchim) is installed facing an exterior-wall PD
Cabinet type: T30 extruded polystyrene foam, No. 3
Shelf type: T30 extruded polystyrene foam No. 3 + T3 polypropylene composite insulation
comments: Where the back of the recessed niche is a masonry wall, apply a 6mm base plaster or one layer of THK9.5 gypsum board; finish concrete walls exposed (no wallpaper)
checkpoints_ko: □ 외벽PD에 면한 부위에 반침이 설치될 경우 결로저감재 설치
□ 가구형 : T30압출법 발포폴리스티렌 3호
□ 선반형 : T30압출법 발포폴리스티렌 3호+T3폴리프로필렌 복합단열재
comments_ko: 반침장 후면이 조적벽일경우 6mm 초벌미장 또는 THK9.5 석고보드 1겹 마감을 하고 콘크리트벽은 노출마감 (도배없음)

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Insulation detail
item: Condensation reinforcement planning inside pipe shafts (PD)
checkpoints: (Where a PD is located on the balcony) Install condensation-reduction material on the exterior-side wall inside the PD (apply bead-method expanded polystyrene for walls, Type 2, No. 2, at 20T/30T by region)

(Where a PD directly faces outside air inside the unit) Install condensation-reduction material on the T-shaped wall inside the PD that has no insulation (apply 10T extruded polystyrene foam moisture-proof board No. 1, bonded)
comments: Where insulation is installed on balcony and indoor T-shaped walls, install wall condensation-reduction material only in districts subject to condensation-prevention performance evaluation (500 units or more)
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-6399 ('20.12.10) · DA-60-008
checkpoints_ko:
□ (발코니에 PD가 있는 경우) PD내 외부측 벽체에 결로저감재 설치
    (결로저감재는 지역별(20T/30T) 벽체 비드법 발포스티렌(2종2호) 적용)

□ (실내에 외기직면 PD가 있는 경우) PD내 단열재 없는 T형 벽체에 결로저감재 설치
    (결로저감재는 10T 압출법 발포폴리스티렌 방습판1호(본드붙임) 적용)
comments_ko: 발코니와 실내 T형 벽체에 단열재 설치한 경우 결로방지 성능평가 대상지구(500호 이상)만 벽체결로저감재 설치

drawing: Performance specification by unit type / Dwelling unit floor plan
item: Compliance with zero-energy Grade 5 insulation planning
checkpoints: Confirm the region (Central 1, Central 2, Southern, Jeju) according to the project site location
Verify the thermal transmittance of exterior walls directly/indirectly facing outside air and of the top and bottom floor slabs, and the insulation type and thickness
Verify the glazing specification and thermal transmittance of windows by location
comments: Verify insulation material and thickness by unit location against the required thermal transmittance
other: Apply the zero-energy multi-family housing Grade 5 design criteria to projects applying for project approval on or after 23.1.1
basis: Design Guideline Article 17 (p. 83) · Housing Technology Group-1243 ('23.3.28) · Construction Standards for Energy-Saving Eco-Friendly Housing, Appendix Table 5
checkpoints_ko: □ 사업지의 위치에 따라 지역(중부1, 중부2, 남부, 제주) 확인
□ 외벽 외기 직·간접면, 바닥 최상·하층 열관류율, 단열재 종류, 두께 확인
□ 부위별 창호 유리 규격, 열관류율 확인
comments_ko: 열관류율에 따른 세대 부위별 단열재 재질 및 두께 확인
other_ko: `23.1.1.이후 사업승인 신청분부터는 제로에너지 공동주택 5등급 설계기준 적용해야 함
basis_ko:
설계지침 제17조(83쪽)
주택기술단-1243(’23.3.28)
에너지절약형 친환경주택의 건설기준 별표5

drawing: Performance specification by unit type / Interior finish schedule
item: Compliance with regional glazing design criteria
checkpoints: Verify U-values by location for each region (Central 1 / Central 2, Southern, Jeju)
Verify glass thickness, double glazing, argon fill, and double-window provision
Directly facing outside air: verify BPW (extended balcony), BP (non-extended balcony), PL (corridor window)
Indirectly facing outside air: verify DPW (non-extended balcony), PW (small room window on the corridor side)
comments: Where window/glazing design criteria are noted on the drawings, show only the window types that apply
basis: Design Guideline Article 17 (p. 94)
checkpoints_ko: □ 지역별(중부1 / 중부2,남부, 제주) 부위별 관류율 값 확인
□ 유리두께, 복층여부, Ar 포함여부, 이중창 여부 등 확인
□ 외기직면 : BPW(확장발코니), BP(비확장발코니), PL(복도창호) 확인
□ 외기간면 : DPW(비확장발코니), PW(복도측 작은방 창호) 확인
comments_ko: 설계도면에 창호/유리 설계기준 표기할 경우 해당되는 창호만 표시되도록 반영

item: Fixing stability of kitchen upper cabinets
checkpoints: The wall to which kitchen upper cabinets are fixed shall in principle be concrete
Provide separate reinforcement details where lightweight partitions or masonry walls are used
Where the wall is not concrete, install a concrete stub wall (w=100) extending down
comments: Where insulation thickness is 180mm or less, bond a reinforcement plate (9*200) to the gypsum board and fix the reinforcement batten (18*45) with anchor bolts. Fix battens at 300mm intervals with an embedment depth of 50mm or to at least the manufacturer's installation specification
other: Submit separate detail drawings, specifications, and test reports, and provide evidence of safety
basis: Design Guideline Article 15 (p. 56) · Customer Quality Innovation Team-988 ('17.3.21)
checkpoints_ko: □ 주방가구 상부장 고정벽은 콘크리트 벽이 원칙
□ 경량벽체 또는 조적벽체 적용 시 별도의 보강 상세 제시
□ 콘크리트 벽이 아닌 경우 콘크리트 수벽(w=100)을 내려 설치
comments_ko: 단열재두께 180mm 이내인 경우 보강판(9*200)을 본드접착하여 석고보드에 붙이고 보강목18*45)을 앵커볼트로 고정. 보강목 고정은 300mm 마다 매입깊이 50mm 또는 제작사 설치사양 이상으로 시공
other_ko: 별도의 상세도, 시방서, 성적서 등을 제시하고 안전에 대한 증빙 필요

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (kitchen cabinets)
item: Verification of installation criteria for built-in furniture and equipment in integrated public rental housing
checkpoints: Apply built-in items to integrated public rental units with an exclusive floor area of 31㎡ or less
Install the built-in washing machine under the kitchen cooktop
Secure a kitchen length of at least 2,100㎜ (to secure cooking space)
Delete the upper refrigerator cabinet in line with the increased refrigerator capacity (180~210L)
Align the height of the deluxe hood and the kitchen upper cabinet at 700mm
comments: (Basic built-in items) air conditioner, refrigerator, electric/gas cooktop, washing machine, storage furniture
other: Confirm the cooktop type according to the unit sizes supplied in the complex and to district/individual heating
basis: Public Housing Planning Office-1686 ('23.05.22) · Public Housing Facilities Office-3879 ('23.12.16) · Public Housing Project Office-2826 ('25.04.28)
item_ko:
통합공공임대 빌트인 가구 
및 설비 설치기준 확인
checkpoints_ko: □ 통합공공임대 전용면적 31㎡ 이하에 빌트인 품목 적용
□ 빌트인 세탁기는 주방쿡탑하부에 설치
□ 주방길이 최소 2,100㎜ 이상 확보 (조리공간 확보)
□ 냉장고 보관 용량 확대(180~210L)에 따라 상부 냉장고장 삭제
□ 디럭스형 후드와 주방가구 상부장 높이는 700mm로 일치
comments_ko: (빌트인 기본 품목) 에어컨, 냉장고, 전기/가스쿡탑, 세탁기, 수납가구
other_ko: 쿡탑은 단지내 공급평형, 지역/개별난방에 따라 설치 종류 확인

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (shoe cabinet)
item: Securing the safety of the entrance shoe cabinet
checkpoints: Top panel (18T MDF) + installation auxiliary batten (15X50) + fixing hardware + adjustment bolt + shoe cabinet reinforcement batten (18X45, L=500) + structural wall
Vary the fixing hardware according to the clearance between the structural frame and the shoe cabinet
comments: Do not fix the adjustment bolt directly to the back panel (3T HPL), as the fixing strength is insufficient
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-5236 ('22.12.05)
checkpoints_ko:
□ 윗판(18T MDF)+시공보조목(15X50)+고정철물+조정용 볼트
    +신발장 보강목(18X45, L=500)+골조벽체
□ 골조와 신발장 이격 거리에 따라 고정철물 변경적용
comments_ko: 조정용 볼트를 뒷판(3T HPL)에 직접 고정시 고정강도가 약하므로 고정 금지

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior (shoe cabinet)
item: Verification of entrance shoe cabinet planning
checkpoints: Secure the shoe cabinet door height (to prevent shoe interference; secure baseboard height at FL +100mm)
Plan the umbrella hook inside the shoe cabinet toward the unit entrance door
Where an aluminum recessed handle is used for the shoe cabinet, install a lower end cap to prevent scratching injuries
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-2029 (2018.04.24.)
checkpoints_ko: □ 신발장 문짝 높이 확보(신발간섭 방지, 걸레받이 높이 확보 FL +100mm)
□ 신발장 내부 우산걸이는 세대현관문 측으로 계획
□ 신발장 손잡이를 AL매립형 적용 시 하단캡 설치하여 긁힘 사고 방지

item: Verification of floor level planning for units for the mobility-impaired
checkpoints: Comply with the floor levels of the entrance, living room, and bathroom in units for the mobility-impaired
Keep the wind-stop threshold at the entrance door at 1.5cm or less, and the entrance threshold frame at 3cm or less
Considering the base frame height (10mm) of the bathroom, keep the level difference from the living room at 2cm or less
EV hall: FL+65, entrance: FL+80, living room: FL+110, bathroom: FL+90
comments: (General unit levels): EV hall: FL+45, entrance: FL+70, living room: FL+110, bathroom: FL+20
basis: Enforcement Decree of the Act on Convenience Promotion for the Disabled, Elderly, and Pregnant Women, Appendix Table 1 · Customer Quality Innovation Team-5635 ('19.9.25)
checkpoints_ko: □ 주거약자세대 현관, 거실, 욕실 등 바닥 level 준수
□ 출입문에 방풍턱 설치시 1.5cm이하, 현관 마루귀틀 설치시 3cm 이하
□ 욕실은 밑틀높이(10mm)를 고려하여 거실과의 단차 2cm 이하
□ EV홀: FL+65, 현관: FL+80, 거실: FL+110, 욕실: FL+90
comments_ko: (일반세대 level) : EV홀: FL+45, 현관: FL+70, 거실: FL+110, 욕실: FL+20

drawing: Dwelling unit floor plan / Interior finish schedule
item: Bathroom and entrance planning for units for the mobility-impaired
checkpoints: Apply slip-resistant floor tiles in the bathroom of units for the mobility-impaired
Reflect a dynamic friction coefficient of 0.65 or more in the interior material finish schedule (0.4 for general units)
Install vertical/horizontal grab bars at the side of the entrance in units for the mobility-impaired (floor level +75~85cm)
comments: In accordance with KS L1001, use floor tiles with a dynamic friction coefficient (wet) of 0.4 or more in toilets and bathrooms for slip resistance, and apply the same to auxiliary welfare facilities
basis: Housing Technology Office-3013 ('21.9.15) · Enforcement Decree of the Act on Convenience Promotion for the Disabled, Elderly, and Pregnant Women, Appendix Table 2 · LHCS 41 48 01 Tile Work
checkpoints_ko: □ 주거약자세대 화장실 미끄럼방지용 바닥타일 적용
□ 동적마찰계수 0.65이상으로 '실내재료마감표에' 반영(일반세대는 0.4)
□ 주거약자세대 현관 측면에 수직/수평손잡이 설치(바닥면+75~85cm)
comments_ko: KS L1001 규정에 의거 화장실 및 욕실 바닥타일은 미끄럼방지를 위해 동적마찰계수(습윤) 0.4 이상 자재 사용하고 부대복리시설도 동일하게 적용
basis_ko:
주택기술처-3013('21.9.15)
주거약자법 시행령 별표2
LHCS 41 48 01 타일공사

drawing: Building floor plan / Core floor plan
item: Review of basement drainage planning
checkpoints: Embed a drainage pipe (Ø50 PVC) at the base of the boundary wall of the basement core (connecting corridor, E/V hall, stairwell)
Install a connecting trench (W=150) from the boundary wall in the PIT to the open trench (W=600)
Route the inflow collected by the floor drain plate through the drainage pipe to connect with the connecting trench in the PIT
Connect the trench in the PIT to the sump, considering the location of the drain-down pipe of the riser
comments: Delete the PIT floor waterproofing (cement liquid waterproofing + protective mortar) and finish with a steel trowel
other: Verify and indicate the route from the basement core through the boundary wall, along the connecting trench in the PIT, to the sump
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-3130 ('20.07.08) · Design Guideline Article 14 (p. 46)
checkpoints_ko: □ 지하코아(연결통로, E/V.홀, 계단실) 경계벽 하부에 배수파이프(Ø50 PVC) 매립
□ PIT 내 경계벽에서 오픈트렌치(W=600)까지 연결트렌치(W=150)를 설치
□ 바닥배수판 유입수는 배수파이프를 지나 PIT내 연결트렌치와 연결
□ PIT 내 트렌치는 설비 입상관의 퇴수관 위치 등을 고려하여 집수정과 연결
comments_ko: PIT 바닥방수(시멘트액체방수+보호몰탈) 삭제하고 쇠흙손 마감
other_ko: 지하코아에서 경계벽 통과후 PIT내 연결트렌치를 지나 집수정까지 연결되는 경로 확인 및 표시

drawing: Building floor plan / Core floor plan
item: Verification of elevator lobby space planning
checkpoints: Connect the elevator to a passage accessible to persons with disabilities
Secure an elevator lobby activity space of 1,400x1,400㎜ or more in front of the E/V
Keep the gap between the lobby floor and the elevator car floor at 3cm or less
comments: Provide the multi-family housing elevator as an accessible elevator, installed as close as possible to the building entrance
basis: Enforcement Rule of the Act on Convenience Promotion for the Disabled, Elderly, and Pregnant Women, Appendix Table 1
checkpoints_ko: □ 승강기는 장애인 등의 접근이 가능한 통로에 연결
□ E/V 전면에 승강장 활동공간 1,400x1,400㎜ 이상 확보
□ 승강장 바닥과 승강기 바닥의 틈은 3cm 이하로 설치
comments_ko: 공동주택의 승강기는 장애인용 승강기로써 가급적 건축물 출입구와 가까운 위치에 설치
basis_ko: 장애인,노인,임산부 등의 편의증진보장에 관한 법 시행규칙 별표1

drawing: Building floor plan / Core floor plan
item: Condensation reduction in stairwells and EV halls
checkpoints: Reflect the condensation-reduction design criteria for basement stairwells and elevator halls of residential towers
In principle, plan so that the exterior walls of stairwells and EV halls do not face soil
Where unavoidable, install a DA (drainage cavity) or double wall to direct condensation
comments: After installing the double wall, review the treatment and drainage plan for external inflow and condensation water
basis: Housing Design Office 2-4517 ('10.11.22)
checkpoints_ko: □ 주동 지하 계단실 및 엘리베이터 홀 결로저감 설계기준 반영
□ 원칙적으로 계단실 및 EV홀 외벽이 흙에 면하지 않도록 계획
□ 불가피한 경우에는 DA 또는 이중벽 설치하여 결로 유도
comments_ko: 이중벽 설치후 외부 유입수 및 결로수 처리 및 배수계획 검토

item: Planning for directing condensation and refrigerant condensate
checkpoints: Plan an open trench and sump in the pit level to direct condensation water
Reflect the plan for directing air-conditioner refrigerant condensate
Apply a forced-exhaust wall-mounted fan to the seasonal storage (PIT area), considering constructability and economy
checkpoints_ko: □ 피트층에 결로수 유도를 위해 오픈트렌치와 집수정 계획
□ 에어컨 냉매수 유도계획 반영
□ 계절창고(PIT부위)는 강제 배기방식 벽부형팬 적용(시공성, 경제성 감안)

item: Separation planning between electrical/generator rooms and residential towers
checkpoints: Separate the electrical and generator room structure from residential towers so that noise and vibration are not transmitted
Plan a double wall where separation is not possible
item_ko: 전기 · 발전기실 및 주거동 이격 계획
checkpoints_ko: □ 소음, 진동이 전달되지 않도록 주거동과 전기 발전기실 구조체 이격
□ 이격 불가시 이중벽 계획

item: Compliance with direct stair installation criteria
checkpoints: Install two or more direct stairs where the total living room floor area per storey is 300㎡ or more (excluding floors with 4 units or fewer)
Keep the travel distance from the living room (at the far end) to the direct stair (door) at 50m or less (40m for 16 storeys or higher)
Where two or more direct stairs are provided, separate them by at least 1/3 of the longest diagonal length of the residential tower
comments: In an apartment, where a unit on the 4th storey or higher cannot use two or more direct stairs, install a refuge area on the balcony (3㎡ for shared use with an adjacent unit, 2㎡ for individual units)
other: Where sprinklers are not installed, provide two direct stairs separated by at least 1/2 of the diagonal length
basis: Enforcement Decree of the Building Act, Article 34, Paragraphs 1 and 2
checkpoints_ko:
□ 각 층별 거실바닥면적 합계가 300㎡ 이상인 경우 2개소 이상 직통계단 설치
    (층당 4세대 이하 제외)
□ 거실(제일 끝)에서 직통계단(문)까지 보행거리는 50m 이하로 설치 (16층 이상 40m)
□ 직통계단 2개소 이상시 주동의 가장 긴 대각선 길이의 1/3이상 이격하여 설치
comments_ko: 아파트로서 4층 이상 층의 각 세대가 2개 이상의 직통계단을 사용할 수 없는 경우 발코니에 대피공간 설치 (인접 세대 공동사용 3㎡, 개별세대 2㎡ 설치)
other_ko: 스프링클러 미설치될 경우 대각선 길이의 1/2이상 이격하여 직통계단 2개소 설치

item: Verification of special evacuation stair installation criteria
checkpoints: Install a special evacuation stair where the building is 16 storeys or more above ground or 3 storeys or more below ground (excluding corridor-access type without corridor windows or floors with a floor area of less than 400㎡)
Provide a vestibule (combined with the elevator lobby) with a door clear width of 0.9m or more, smoke control equipment, and a 60-minute fire door
Provide a fire elevator lobby area of 6㎡ or more per car
comments: Where a special evacuation stair is required, verify that the vestibule is not omitted at the corridor end in addition to the core side
basis: Enforcement Decree of the Building Act, Article 35 · Design Guideline Article 14 (pp. 33, 34, etc.)
checkpoints_ko:
□ 지상16층 이상 또는 지하3층 이하일 경우에는 특별피난계단 설치
    (복도창호가 없는 갓복도형 또는 바닥면적 400㎡미만인 층은 제외)
□ 부속실(승강장과 겸용) 출입문 유효폭 0.9m 이상, 제연설비, 60분방화문 등 설치
□ 비상용 승강기 승강장 면적은 1대당 6㎡ 이상 설치
comments_ko: 특별피난계단 설치대상인 경우 코아쪽 외에 복도끝에 특별피난계단의 경우부속실이 누락되지 않도록 확인
basis_ko:
건축법 시행령 제35조
설계지침 제14조(33, 34쪽 등)

Secure a clear width of 1,200mm or more for single-loaded corridors
Secure a clear width of 1,800mm or more for double-loaded corridors (where living spaces face each other, regardless of the entrance)
(Privacy) Do not plan unit entrance doors facing each other (arrange diagonally)
(Privacy) Plan so that unit entrance doors do not directly face the corridor or EV hall (arrange diagonally)
(Privacy) Avoid tower plans in which balconies of adjacent units face each other at 90 degrees
comments: Secure a corridor width of 1,500mm or more for units designed for persons with disabilities
basis: Regulations on Housing Construction Standards, Article 17 · Design Guideline Article 14 (p. 41)
checkpoints_ko: □ 복도폭은 선홈통, 계량기, 손잡이 등 시설물을 제외한 실제 보행가능 유효폭으로 산정
□ 편복도 유효폭 1,200mm 이상 확보
□ 중복도 유효폭 1,800mm 이상 확보(거실공간이 서로 마주보는 경우, 출입구와 무관)
□ (사생활보호)세대와 세대의 현관문이 마주보는 계획 금지 (사선배치)
□ (사생활보호)세대현관문이 복도 또는 E/V홀을 직접 마주보지 않도록 계획 (사선배치)
□ (사생활보호)세대와 세대의 발코니가 90도로 마주보는 주동계획 지양
comments_ko: 장애인 적용세대의 복도는 1,500mm 이상 확보
basis_ko:
주택건설기준등에 관한 규정 제17조
설계지침 제14조(41쪽)

checkpoints: Plan to avoid interference with the pump box, corridor beam, entrance door leaf, PD access panel, and similar elements

checkpoints_ko: □ 양수기함, 복도 보, 현관 문짝, PD 점검구 등과 간섭되지 않도록 계획
□ 주동 우수선홈통 라인은 6~7m 배치간격 유지
□ 입주민 보행동선 방해, 세대현관문과 간섭, 미관 저해 여부 확인 후 개선
comments_ko: 복도식 아파트의 경우 옥상에서 부터 복도를 지나 지하 배수로에 이르기 까지 우수계획을 확인하고 우수선홈통 위치 적정성 확인

drawing: Building floor plan / Core floor plan
item: Review of elevator lobby window design in stair-access apartments
checkpoints: A 2m or greater separation from other windows is not required for windows of the stairwell and vestibule (elevator lobby)

Where within 2m of another window, wired glass is not required (as fire compartments are provided every 200㎡ of floor area and the floor area per storey is 400㎡ or less, the stair does not qualify as an evacuation stair or special evacuation stair)
basis: Public Housing Project Office-5386 ('14.11.06) · Enforcement Decree of the Building Act, Article 35
item_ko: 계단실형 아파트 승강장 창호 설계 검토
checkpoints_ko: □ 계단실 및 부속실(승강장) 창호로 부터 다른 창문으로 부터 2m 이상 이격 불필요

item: Vibration and noise mitigation planning for units adjacent to elevator shafts
checkpoints: Locate the E/V away from dwelling units so that it does not face them in the tower plan
Where unavoidable, install a double wall or relocate the counterweight away from the units
comments: Locate the E/V away from dwelling units to prevent noise and vibration
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-5235 (21.12.02)
checkpoints_ko: □ 주동 계획시 세대에 면하지 않도록 E/V 이격하여 설치
□ 불가피한 경우 이중벽 설치 또는 균형추를 세대에서 멀리 위치 이동
comments_ko: 소음과 진동방지를 위해 E/V는 세대에서 멀리 배치

item: Verification of mailbox installation criteria compliance
checkpoints: (Rental) Apply standard mailboxes + smart registered mailbox (integrated type) (install 10% of the units per core at the 1st-floor building entrance)
(Rental) Apply the unmanned parcel delivery system (integrated type) (install 5% of the units per core and control it integrally with the smart registered mailbox)
(For-sale) Apply smart mailboxes / unmanned parcel delivery system (integrated type) (install 15% of the units per core at the 1st-floor building entrance)
basis: Public Housing Facilities Office-545 ('24.02.13.) · Smart Housing Office-3213 ('19.09.08.)
checkpoints_ko:
□ (임대) 일반우편함+스마트등기함(통합형) 적용
                (코어별 세대수의 10%를 1층 동출입구에 설치)

□ (임대) 무인택배시스템(통합형) 적용
                (코어별 세대수의 5%를 설치하고 스마트 등기함과 통합 제어)

□ (분양) 스마트우편함 적용 / 무인택배시스템(통합형)

Install braille blocks 30cm away from the start and end of stairs
Show them on the overall building floor plan and core plan of the building containing units for the mobility-impaired
basis: Design Guideline Article 14 (p. 40)

□ 주거약자세대가 계획된 동 전체평면도 및 코아평면도에 표현

drawing: Building floor plan / Core floor plan

checkpoints: Delete the vestibule space at roof level (retain minimum walls only)

checkpoints: Minimize bends in stormwater downspout connections and avoid exposure on the exterior
Considering the exterior wall stone finish at the ground-floor main entrance canopy and auxiliary welfare facilities, change the downspout material in those areas to stainless steel (STS)
basis: Private-Financed Housing Business Division-1858 ('14.04.04)
checkpoints_ko: □ 우수 선홈통 연결꺾임 최소화하고 외부 노출 지양

□ 1층 주현관 캐노피, 부대복리시설 등의 외벽 석재마감을 고려하여 해당부위의 선홈통의
     재질은 STS재로 변경

item: Comply with exterior wall molding design criteria
checkpoints: (Rental) Show semi-noncombustible metal molding on the elevation drawing
(For-sale) Show stone molding or semi-noncombustible metal molding on the elevation drawing
basis: Housing Technology Division-2833 ('18.07.26)

□ (분양) 석재몰딩 또는 준불연 메탈몰딩 입면도 표기

□ 줄눈 깊이 기준 : 콘크리트벽단면 1/5 이상

item: Accessible entrance door clearance planning
checkpoints: Clear passage width of entrance doors: 0.9 m or more
Clear distance in front of entrance doors: 1.2 m or more
Where the door is not automatic, secure a maneuvering space of 0.6 m or more beside the entrance door
comments: Where a swing door opens inward, provide a maneuvering space of at least 600 mm beside the entrance so users can step aside as the door opens
other: Eliminate the level difference between the entrance floor and the door threshold (2 cm or less for fire doors); position the door handle grip center 0.8 m to 0.9 m above the floor
basis: Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of Convenience for Persons with Disabilities, the Elderly, and Pregnant Women, Annex Table 1
checkpoints_ko: □ 출입구(문) 통과유효폭은 0.9m 이상
□ 출입구(문) 전면 유효거리 1.2m 이상
□ 자동문이 아닌 경우 출입문 옆 0.6m 이상 활동공간 확보
comments_ko: 여닫이 문이 안으로 열리는 경우 문이 열릴 때 출입구 옆에 600mm 이상의 활동공간을 둬서 피할 수 있도록 해야 함
other_ko: 출입구의 바닥면과 문턱의 단차 삭제하고(방화문의 경우 2cm 이하) 출입문 손잡이는 중앙지점이 바닥면에서 0.8m~0.9m 사이에 위치

Verify the wall opening size (300x1,200) at the automatic pressure differential damper in the E/V shaft
Damper installation height: 1,500 mm from the finished floor to the top of the opening
comments: Where the E/V shaft uses pressurized supply smoke control, the automatic pressure differential damper is located in the structural frame beside the elevator door
basis: Customer Quality Innovation Team-3130 ('20.07.08) · Design Guideline Article 14 (p. 33)

□ 자동차압댐퍼 설치위치는 바닥마감에서 개구부 상단까지 1,500mm
comments_ko: 승강로 급기가압 제연방식의 경우 자동차압댐퍼가 승강기 출입문 옆 골조에 위치

□ (계단실형) 3.0m 콘크리트 벽체 2면 이상 확보 (W2.0m xD1.0m)

PVC may be applied to stormwater drains on the penthouse roof
Show stormwater pipes on the elevation drawings and the total design
comments: Secure completion quality of the building exterior design

(Rental) Apply powder coating for the railing at the stairwell ribbon window
Verify railing height of H=1200 from the floor

checkpoints_ko: □ 주동 계단실 연창부위 하부 물막이턱 설치 (테라조타일 100x25)

Machine room floor finish: THK100 plain concrete plus epoxy paint (skirting: 80 mm)
Verify roof slope construction (1/50 to 1/150)
Show protection concrete joints at 2,500x2,500
Railing height: 1,400 mm (structural height)

Lowest floor slab thickness 210 mm, floor-to-floor height 2,850 mm

     까지만 커튼박스 설치
